name: Rinus Michels

spellsCounted.reason: Four Eredivisie titles (1966, 1967, 1968, 1970), European Cup 1970-71; Total Football (totaalvoetbal) origin. Start date verified (FIFA: appointed 22 January 1965).
La Liga 1973-74 with Cruyff; 4-3-3 with pressing and offside line carried over (Spanish and Marinho sources).
1974 World Cup runner-up; overlaps the Barcelona spell, both count. First match date 27 March 1974 seen only in a search summary (Cavac); World Cup final 7 July 1974.

spellsExcluded.reason: Decided by user: excluded (second spell, Copa del Rey 1978)

scopeNote: Rinus Michels in his three counted spells (Ajax 1965-71, Barcelona 1971-75, Netherlands 1974). Style named by sources: Total Football (totaalvoetbal), described as proactive football: positional interchange in vertical lines, 4-3-3 shape, collective pressing with space reduction, high line with offside trap, goalkeeper as sweeper (Jongbloed 1974). The popular label 'anti-tactics' (FIFA) means flexible positions, not no organisation. Barcelona question: sources (Substack, Marinho in Irish Times/Guardian, La Nacion) say Michels brought the 4-3-3, pressing, possession and the pushed-up offside line to Barcelona, so the Ajax system was played there, with Cruyff only from October 1973 and results short of Ajax in 1971-73; evidence for Barcelona is tier C and retrospective. All evidence is retrospective (no contemporary 1960s-70s press was accessible). Statedview dates: 1974 for the war quote is only the Dutch column placement (attributed); 2020 for the FIFA and Substack quotes is the article year because the quotes are undated (late in life / after retirement); the 2001 quote is a Sky Sports interview about 1965. Excluded spells 1978-80 and 1980-83 have year-only dates because the exact day was not researched. Dates given as seasons where the day could not be found. Marking (zonal vs man) has no source that states it directly: FourFourTwo says Total Football exposed the limits of man-marking, while Neeskens was sent after the opposing playmaker (Irish Times), so a space-oriented block with one assigned man-marking role is the best reading.
openQuestions: Zonal vs man-marking at Ajax is not stated by any readable source; only inferred (FourFourTwo vs Neeskens assigned to the playmaker).

Origin and date of 'Voetbal is oorlog': one Dutch column places it at the 1974 World Cup, Onze Taal says 1970s, Jungle World says it is a shortening of a longer remark that Michels resisted; the English form is attributed, no primary source found.
Wikipedia and a search summary say Michels played an offside trap at Ajax; the only verified pre-1974 statements are Irish Times (Vasovic, Blankenburg stepping up) and Guide to Football.
Set-pieces: only 1974 goals from corner and free kick found; no statement of Michels' set-piece design.
Contested credit: Total Football attributed to Michels versus Cruyff and the Ajax players (Irish Times says Michels himself said it developed semi-organically).
Cruyff's Barcelona league debut date (28 Oct 1973) and the Hoek van Holland 1974 camp rules were seen only in search summaries or not at all.
Michels' first Netherlands match 27 March 1974 only in a search summary (Cavac).

statedView.quote: Football is something like war. Whoever behaves too properly is lost.

I needed to change my approach and needed to make it clear to everyone that even though they [the players] were semi-professionals, money and spectator numbers were at stake. And for that they needed to do certain things, and stop others.

It is an art in itself to compose a starting team, finding the balance between creative players and those with destructive powers, and between defence, construction and attack, never forgetting the quality of the opposition and the specific pressures of each match.
